newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's short-term PHIBOR slips, others steady.
newsitem.headline: Manila's short-term PHIBOR slips, others steady.

text.p: Short-term Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) weakened following the easing of spot short-term rates, traders said.
"The one- and two-week PHIBOR were just following the spot market rates," one trader said. He said the rates has softened since many banks have already squared their position for the week.
The other rates were steady as bankers wait for a clearer direction in the secondary Treasury bill rates. The government has suspended the weekly auction scheduled for Monday due to the APEC summit.
